objective: Take up backlog B163 (G8 with G1) at the owner's word of 2026-11-12: what subtraction and division of logical harmonies are, without the zero the not-all-equal law cannot make. A harmony is read as a periodic base along one shift whose allowed states all repeat (A70). Prove the stitching lemma (any law: stitched states repeat with period lcm(p, q), the pairs of two orbits fall into gcd(p, q) offsets kept or removed whole, no beat) and the mirror's pairing of offsets under not-all-equal; run an exact census of one-shift patterns of up to three knot kinds and span 2 to 10 under not-all-equal and three control laws, and of every stitch of the harmonies' orbits. Plan in research/HARMONY-ARITH-20261112-001/preregistration.md.
stop_rule: The census run once on the frozen range; then report and hold.
title: Arithmetic of harmonies without a zero
